title: A Non-Linear Neuron Based Detection of Isolated Pixels in Binary and Grayscale Images using Contrast Sensitive Receptive Fields
abstract: arXiv:2609.18399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying isolated points is important in image processing applications such as medical imaging, astronomy and quality control management. Other domains, such as cybersecurity, also present challenges that can be framed as image processing problems. One example of particular interest is the identification of anomalous single nodes in spatially organised networks where groups of nodes in different regions share similar feature values. This task can involve both binary and more complex grayscale images. However, existing methods face limitations: template matching is infeasible for grayscale images, while 2nd order derivative based methods are highly sensitive to noise and require user-specified thresholds. To overcome these issues, a novel method is proposed for detecting meaningful single-pixel deviations in images. translated_title: 一种基于非线性神经元的二值与灰度图像孤立像素检测方法：使用对比度敏感的感受野
translated_abstract: 识别孤立点在医学成像、天文学和质量控制管理等图像处理应用中非常重要。其他领域（如网络安全）也提出了可被构建为图像处理问题的挑战。一个特别值得关注的例子是在空间组织化网络中识别异常的单节点，其中不同区域的节点组共享相似的特征值。这项任务可能同时涉及二值图像和更复杂的灰度图像。然而，现有方法存在局限性：模板匹配对于灰度图像不可行，而基于二阶导数的方法对噪声高度敏感且需要用户手动指定阈值。为了克服这些问题，本文提出了一种用于检测图像中有意义的单像素偏差的新方法。该方法修改并扩展了一个最初为异常检测而设计的神经元模型，使其能够在空间……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于非线性神经元模型、采用对比度敏感感受野的新方法，用于检测二值和灰度图像中的孤立像素异常点，克服了模板匹配不适用于灰度图像以及二阶导数方法对噪声敏感、需要人工设定阈值等局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel method based on a non-linear neuron model with contrast-sensitive receptive fields to detect isolated single-pixel anomalies in binary and grayscale images, overcoming the limitations of template matching and noise-sensitive second-order derivative methods that require user-specified thresholds.
